title: Breakouts
summary: A breakout is price moving out through a support or resistance zone. Decide in advance what counts, for example a close a set distance beyond the zone.
unreliableWhen: Many breakouts fail and come back inside. Around news, fills can be worse than planned. Without a written rule, any wick looks like a breakout afterwards.
goodExample: Rule: a close at least 5 pips above the zone. A candle closes 8 pips above, so it counts. You still place a stop.
badExample: Calling a wick through the line a breakout, then changing the rule so the chart fits.

chart.lookFor: Mark the range with the Zone tool. Find the first candle that closed beyond it by your written distance. Note how far price went before its first pullback.
